item.title: Psychic Girls! ~Ore to Kanojo no Koi no Yukue~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Akagiridan
  • 発売日: 2018-11-03
  • スコア: なし
  • 日本語名: サイキックガールズ! ～俺と彼女の恋のゆくえ～
  • 英語名: Psychic Girls! Ore to Kanojo no Koi no Yukue

あらすじ

Takaharu Midou transfers to Kurishima Academy due to his parents’ change in the workplace.

He takes other students’ attention as most transfer students do, and especially,

Maho Tsukishima and Mitsuki Saionji get interested in him and they become friendly.

In fact, the two have supernatural abilities and are called “psychic girls”!

别名

あらすじ

In a new world of humans with supernatural powers,

Masatsugu Tatsumi is forced to enroll in an all-supernatural school.

Being comparatively powerless, anything could kill him.

He survives countless dangers in the ordinary course of a day.
